about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan at (2,2) with a folder of DarkWide T in both games, BN5's chip 192 by BN5's own code and the registry's 216 by the same code moved (BN5's spread family 0x25 as BN6's 0x75, subfamily 2, its graphics BN5's; a DarkChip of the registry's, dealt straight into the battle deck; KnightSoul held in both (flags5, souls6), so BN6's engine has the Souls and with them BN5's mood and DarkChip rule (S7)), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/MULTIROM.md, The chips' code).
subject: megaman

verdict.why: BN5's DarkChip rule as the Souls track's S7 brought it holds (KnightSoul held in both, souls6: the Souls installed and with them BN5's mood, src/emu/soulmood.c: his mood 0 in both as the chip is used); what differs from t32 is what BN5's DarkChip use does past it that no track ports yet (docs/MULTIROM.md, Transplanted Souls, S7's open): the chip's after-effect on his NaviStats (BN5 0x0802C938: the player block's +0x14 by 4), his object's +0x94 (3) and the random numbers it draws (BN5 0x080197B1); DarkWide's own code moved plays as BN5's (its flash 0x37 from the helper's copy of BN5's table, its wide shot, the third kind's 0x3B); --survey: its afterimage (the fourth kind's 0x28) draws MegaMan's own sprite, each game's own (MEGAMAN_LOADS), apart in its bytes with the spec's sprites: bytes
